statements.status_notes: CVE-2020-8912 affects the deprecated AWS S3 Crypto SDK client-side encryption implementation in github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go/service/s3/s3crypto. Node Problem Detector includes aws-sdk-go v1.44.72 only as an indirect module dependency; none of its shipped binaries import s3crypto, so that package is not compiled into the image. The GitHub advisory also identifies aws-sdk-go versions before v1.34.0 as affected, while this image contains v1.44.72.

CVE-2020-8912 affects the deprecated AWS S3 Crypto SDK client-side encryption implementation in github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go/service/s3/s3crypto. Node Problem Detector includes aws-sdk-go v1.44.72 only as an indirect module dependency; none of its shipped binaries import s3crypto, so that package is not compiled into the image. The GitHub advisory also identifies aws-sdk-go versions before v1.34.0 as affected, while this image contains v1.44.72.

CVE-2020-8912 affects in-band key negotiation in the deprecated AWS S3 Crypto SDK for Go V1 clients in github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go/service/s3/s3crypto. OpenCost includes github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go transitively, but the source tree does not import service/s3/s3crypto or call the vulnerable client-side encryption APIs, so the affected path is not executable in this image.
